Prisoner Shot Dead in Jaipur; International Reports Detail Other Fatal Shootings

A prisoner, Mohan Kumawat, serving a sentence, was shot and killed in Jaipur during daylight hours. The incident occurred in the Karni Vihar area. Police have launched an investigation into the murder, with masked assailants reportedly involved. Separately, international news outlets reported on multiple fatal shootings and stabbings in the UK, Australia, Canada, and the US, involving various victims and circumstances, including a police officer being shot during a traffic stop in Calgary.
